title: Snap-in desk cable clip
prompt: A desk-edge cable clip for three 4 mm cables: C-clamp that grips a 25 mm desk edge without screws, three rounded cable channels on top, printable flat.
lesson: Snap-in desk cable clip — farmed pattern for "cable"-class prompts. Judge 80/100.
code:
from build123d import *

# ---------------- Parameters ----------------
desk_th      = 25.0          # desk edge thickness to grip
grip_clear   = 0.5           # clearance so it slips over the desk
gap          = desk_th + grip_clear   # jaw opening

wall         = 4.0           # clamp wall / arm thickness (load-bearing)
back_h       = 40.0          # vertical spine height (spans the desk edge)
top_len      = 30.0          # top arm reach (over the desk top)
bot_len      = 22.0          # bottom arm reach (under the desk)

body_w       = 44.0          # width of the clip (holds 3 channels)

cable_d      = 4.0           # cable diameter
cable_clear  = 0.6           # channel a touch larger than the cable
chan_r       = (cable_d + cable_clear) / 2
n_chan       = 3
chan_pitch   = 12.0          # centre-to-centre of channels
chan_open    = 3.2           # mouth opening width (< cable_d, snap retention)

fil_big      = 3.0
fil_med      = 2.0
fil_small    = 1.0
cham_base    = 0.8

# ---------------- Sanity checks ----------------
assert chan_r > cable_d / 2, "channel must clear the cable"
assert (n_chan - 1) * chan_pitch + 2 * chan_r + 2 * wall < body_w + 8, "channels fit on top arm"
assert wall >= 3.0, "arms must be thick enough not to snap"
assert chan_open < cable_d, "channel mouth must retain the cable"

# ---------------- C-clamp body (side profile in XZ, extruded in Y) ----------------
# Build the C profile: vertical spine + top arm + bottom arm around the gap.
with BuildPart() as clamp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as prof:
        with BuildLine() as ln:
            # start at back-bottom, go up the spine, out the top, down front,
            # into the jaw, and back to close.
            pts = [
                (0, 0),
                (0, back_h),
                (top_len, back_h),
                (top_len, back_h - wall),
                (wall, back_h - wall),
                (wall, wall),                       # inner spine
                (bot_len, wall),
                (bot_len, 0),
                (0, 0),
            ]
            Polyline(*pts)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=body_w / 2, both=True)

    # ---- rounded cable channels on the TOP surface of the top arm ----
    top_face_z = back_h
    xs = [(i - (n_chan - 1) / 2) * chan_pitch for i in range(n_chan)]
    # channels run along X (the reach direction) so cables route off the desk edge
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(top_face_z)) as chans:
        with Locations(*[(top_len * 0.45, y) for y in xs]):
            pass
    # cut channels: cylinders along X at each Y position, sitting in the top surface
    for y in xs:
        with Locations((top_len * 0.5, y, top_face_z)):
            Cylinder(chan_r, top_len, rotation=(0, 90, 0), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
        # narrow slot mouth so the cable snaps in and is retained
        with Locations((top_len * 0.5, y, top_face_z + chan_r * 0.4)):
            Box(top_len, chan_open, chan_r * 1.2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- edge treatment ----
    # Outer vertical corners of the body (along Y) - primary visible form
    fillet(clamp.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y).group_by(Axis.Z)[-1], fil_med)

    # Round the exposed side edges of the C profile (front/back long edges)
    # Base build-plate chamfer (bottom of bottom arm)
    base_edges = clamp.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[0]
    chamfer(base_edges, cham_base)

    # Soften the tip of the top and bottom arms
    tip_edges = clamp.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y).filter_by(
        lambda e: e.center().X > top_len - 0.5)
    try:
        fillet(tip_edges, fil_small)
    except Exception:
        pass

result = clamp.part
